rules.text: Never fire a shot you can't afford.
rules.read_back: Whenever the tank fires, the shot power must be between 0.1 and 3.0 (100 to 3000) and strictly less than the tank's current energy, and if it doesn't fire this rule says nothing.
clauses: r.fire matches Some(p) ==> (((p.0 as int) >= 100) && ((p.0 as int) <= 3000) && ((obs.energy.0 as int) > (p.0 as int)))

rules.text: Only fire at a robot you saw this turn, with the gun aimed at it.
rules.read_back: Whenever the tank fires, it must have a scanned target whose scan is from this turn (age 0) and its gun must point at that target within 3.0°, and if it doesn't fire this rule imposes nothing.
clauses: r.fire matches Some(p) ==> ((obs.target matches Some(t) && t.age == 0) && aimed(*obs))

rules.text: Never drive toward a wall or building closer than 80 px.
rules.read_back: Whenever the tank drives forward by a distance a, the free space ahead must be at least a plus 80 pixels, and whenever it drives backward by a distance, the free space behind must be at least that distance plus 80 pixels, while not driving (or no move) is unconstrained.
clauses: r.ahead matches Some(a) ==> (a > 0 ==> ((around.clearance_ahead as int) >= ((a as int) + 80)))
r.ahead matches Some(a) ==> (a < 0 ==> ((around.clearance_behind as int) >= (80 - (a as int))))

explanation.headline: Proved: all 3 rules hold
explanation.summary: Verus proved all three rules: S1 (never fire a shot it can't afford), S2 (only fire at a robot seen this turn with the gun aimed), and S3 (never drive toward a wall or building closer than 80 px). Neither the open arena battle nor the urban battle recorded any rule violations.
